Download **AutobahnRush.apk** below, open it on your Android phone and allow installing apps from this source when asked.

- Leave the Autobahn: signed exits (Vorwegweiser, countdown boards, Ausfahrt) onto a curving Landstraße through fields, farms and tree-lined avenues, with Kreisstraßen, gravel Feldwege and on-ramps back; real German signs throughout; cars, tractors and the Polizei follow you there
- Six new cars: a portal-axle off-roader, two performance SUVs, a rally 911, a 911 GT3 RS and an AMG GT Black Series-style coupé
- Much easier steering between 70 and 150 km/h; rear-drive cars drift more than all-wheel drive
- Cleaner supercars (no more parts sticking out) and smoother interiors
- Half as many wind streaks

If no release key is configured yet (see docs/ANDROID.md), the APK is debug-signed and an update may need the old version uninstalled first.
